market_summary: USD pairs (EURUSD and GBPUSD) are experiencing strong volume-confirmed bearish breakdowns below their respective Value Area Lows during the London session, supported by expanding ATR and strongly negative CVD. Gold and US100 remain in uptrends above VWAP/EMA50 but are consolidating against session resistance with weak momentum. BTCUSD is stalled near session highs on very low volume and diverging CVD, suggesting patience across non-FX assets while trading momentum breakdowns on EURUSD and GBPUSD.

signals.rationale: Price sits above VAH (4055.48) and POC (4044.58) in LONDON_SESSION, holding above VWAP (4047.79) and EMA50 (4050.38). However, CVD is NEUTRAL (+0.12) with a negative slope (-0.5), and recent price rejected near the Session High (4066.79) under mid-channel ATR conditions with low RVOL (0.879). Lacking clear volume-backed momentum to continue buying near resistance.

Price is below VAL (1.11567) and POC (1.11652) during LONDON_SESSION, breaking key support at Session Low (1.11470). Trend is bearish below downward-sloping VWAP (1.11610) and EMA50 (1.11644). Confirmed by strong yellow RVOL spike (2.002) and strongly negative BEARISH CVD (-6,436.18 with a steep negative slope of -5,276.50), pushing price toward lower ATR band.
signals.level_event: breakout below Session Low 1.11470 and VAL 1.11567

signals.rationale: Price trades below VAL (1.33365) and POC (1.33478) in LONDON_SESSION, well under VWAP (1.33425) and EMA50 (1.33474). A clean bearish expansion bar is breaking Session Low (1.33248) backed by high RVOL (2.582 yellow spike) and aligned BEARISH CVD (-1,421.17 with slope -3,166.85). ATR expanding as price pushes toward lower ATR band (1.33283) aiming for Prev Low liquidity.
signals.level_event: breakout below VAL 1.33365 and testing Session Low 1.33248

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 27987.93 .. VAH 28187.63) and above POC (28113.83) in LONDON_SESSION. Although above VWAP (28038.86) and EMA50 (27989.73) with BULLISH CVD (+6.60), price is stalling right at upper ATR band (28189.65) and testing Session High / VAH resistance (28187.63). Dukascopy tick volume caveat applies, but buying directly into session high resistance without a pullback or clear acceptance above VAH warrants a HOLD.

Price is above VAH (73808.59) and POC (73699.92) during LONDON_SESSION, trading above VWAP (73616.71) and EMA50 (73674.64). However, CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.03) showing a divergence, and volume is extremely low (RVOL 0.45, no spikes). Price is stalled right below Session High (74085.20) and upper ATR band (74150.55), indicating low-conviction exhaustion near resistance.
